title: Breast Implant Size Calculator, CC Chart & Size Guide
meta_description: Estimate your implant size in cc from your band and cup with our free calculator, then read the CC chart, profiles and what your surgeon measures.
excerpt: Use the calculator, then read the real numbers: a CC chart built on a measured rule of about 130 to 150 cc per cup, dimensions for 300cc, 400cc and 500cc implants, high vs moderate profile, and why height and weight don't set your size.
quick_answer:
What size breast implant should I get?

There is no standard size: it depends on your breast width, your tissue and the look you want. In ASPS's 2025 survey, surgeons ranked 300 to 400 cc among the implants they use most, with 200 to 300 cc second. A 2017 study put one cup size at about 130 to 150 cc, a rough rule.

sources.title: A system for breast implant selection based on patient tissue characteristics and implant-soft tissue dynamics (2002)
